source.attribution: Georg Möller, Hieratische Paläographie, retro-digitised by AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 11814

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 11814; AKU grapheme R0240 (AKU GR 521). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: R14 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 579, 579 (v4p10), 579 (v4p2). Source publication of this facsimile: Möller 1927a, p. 55, no. 579. Occurrence: line 3; find place Ägypten (unlokalisiert); writing direction "Zeilen, linksläufig prograd"; sign size 12.3 x 6.8 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Zweite Zwischenzeit, 17. Dynastie". Facsimile type: Retro-Digitalisat (Publikation), by Georg Möller. Source scan (WEBP) converted to PNG at native resolution, flattened onto white, white margin added.
